deviations.title: subnormal (denormal) float32 *operands* are flushed to zero + subnormal (denormal) float32 *results* are flushed to (signed) zero
deviations.root_cause: the JIT-compiled kernel does not preserve subnormal operands (grid values and tree constants alike) -- they behave as 0.0 -- while reference_eval is correctly rounded and keeps them.
